summary: Script excellent (bash idioms, set -euo pipefail, quoted vars, modular design). Workflow well-structured (matrix testing, CI markers, job dependencies) but incomplete. Hard failures: fixture files and rules.conf referenced but missing, no act-result.txt creation step (explicit hard requirement 'MUST exist'). Workflow cannot execute without supporting files. No external test harness for repeated 'act push' invocations per 'ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT' requirement.
